items.mainDefect: The login IdP cache (cacheKeyForLogin) is not invalidated when OrganizationProvider.addIdentityProvider/removeIdentityProvider links or unlinks an IdP, so login pages show stale brokers.

secondary.defect: The login IdP cache is not invalidated when an organization's enabled state (OrganizationModel.isEnabled) is toggled.

items.mainDefect: Lookups in MetricsEndpoint that only match exact values like 'public' use string-pattern (regex) matching instead of a direct equals or set lookup.

secondary.defect: Regex patterns in MetricsEndpoint may not be anchored (e.g. ^fetch.*$), or may be applied to the wrong field, so matching or escaping errors can go unnoticed.
